text: {"lessons":["I should not treat a few months of gains or losses as proof that a trading decision was good or bad; I need to judge it against a clear plan.","Repeatedly buying Stocks C and D and selling Stocks B and E should be based on each stock’s outlook and my target allocation, not just recent price moves or whether I’m up or down.","Because I want to buy an apartment within ten years, I should manage risk and keep enough cash for my needs rather than chasing fast growth."]}
